text: {"lessons":["A few months of modest gains or losses are not enough to judge a strategy, so I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations.","Buying several stocks spread my purchases across different holdings; I should keep diversification in mind and make sure any buys fit my cash and risk limits.","My apartment goal is years away, so I should make deliberate decisions aligned with it rather than trade frequently just because I check my account often."]}
